FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Bridal Bliss Boutique, we specialize in providing a personalized shopping experience for brides-to-be, offering a curated selection of wedding gowns, bridesmaids' dresses, and accessories. Our operations are structured around individual appointments to ensure that each customer receives dedicated attention from our knowledgeable bridal consultants. We work closely with reputable suppliers to maintain high-quality products and reliable inventory turnover. The boutique is designed to create a comfortable and elegant atmosphere, allowing brides to explore our collections and experience fittings in a private setting. Our team is trained in customer service excellence and we conduct regular staff training sessions on data privacy to ensure the protection of our clients' sensitive information. Committed to compliance with local regulations, we maintain all necessary licenses and have an updated incident response plan to handle any unexpected events.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that it maintains documented cybersecurity controls, including secure payment processing and data encryption. Additionally, we have a written and tested incident response plan for cyber events, actively manage our inventory to ensure turnover, and have established reliable vendor relationships to avoid supply chain disruptions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 12, 2022, we experienced a minor water leak in our fitting room area, causing damage to inventory. The leak was promptly repaired, and affected items were assessed, resulting in a loss amount of $3,500. The status of this claim is closed, and no further action is required.
